q1_issues.issue: "a decision on a new roof" is a noun-attached about-PP, which the instruction set explicitly excludes from Theme and Patient, and this also puts a thematic role atom — whose form is (<Role> <event> <filler>) — on the non-event entity sk_decision_1.

q2_gaps: noun-attached PP modifier / about-phrase ("a decision on a new roof", "a photo of Mary"): the instruction set rules the about-phrase out of the possessive mapping and shows only entity-attached "from" keeping its surface preposition, but states no general form for such a PP

light / support-verb construction over an event noun ("reaches a decision"): the light-verb rule covers only occurred / happened / took place, and only for attaching tense and Time, so nothing says whether this is a reach event over a decision entity or one decide eventuality
notes: Theme on reach's direct object matches the instruction set's own "Sara reached the platform" example, and the collective-noun subject, the un-fused "new roof", and the absent status atom are all correct.
